chars.FOUR: Four hired muscular men, all wearing identical black bomber jackets, black jeans and black beanies, one with a red beard, one bald with sunglasses on his head, one with a moustache, one tall and skinny.
chars.VICTIM: A middle-aged man in a white bathrobe and slippers, dark slicked-back hair.
chars.BOSS: BOSS: a bald heavy-set Russian man with a grey goatee, wearing a burgundy velvet blazer over a black shirt and a thick gold chain.
chars.GUARDS: GUARDS: three tall broad bodyguards in identical black suits, white shirts, black ties and coiled earpieces, short blond buzz cuts.
chars.TOM: TOM: a young American groom with messy blond hair, wearing a light blue suit, white shirt with open collar and a pink 'groom' sash.

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Night in a luxurious Las Vegas hotel corridor with red carpet and golden lamps. The four men stagger drunkenly, laughing, leaning on each other, one holding a bottle.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: In the hotel corridor two identical suite doors face each other. The four drunk men stand at the LEFT door, one knocking hard on it, the others looking confused at the door on the right.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: Inside a dim hotel suite doorway, the four men grab the surprised man in the bathrobe, putting a black blindfold over his eyes while he struggles in shock.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: A huge luxurious penthouse suite with a view of the Las Vegas Strip lights at night. The Russian boss walks in from the elevator, frowning, looking around the empty room.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: In the luxurious penthouse suite the bodyguards stand waiting near an open door, one checking his watch, one touching his earpiece with a suspicious face.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: The bodyguards sprint down a concrete hotel staircase with emergency lights, angry and determined, one pointing ahead.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: In a dark underground hotel parking garage, the bodyguards pin the four men against a black van, the four men raising their hands in fear.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: Tom sits alone on a sofa in his hotel suite decorated with bachelor party balloons, checking his phone and the door, confused and waiting.
